newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle unchanged at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle unchanged at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry was strong and demand light.

Sales confirmed on 3,300 slaughter steers and 1,500 slaughter heifers early Thursday. Week to date 84,400 head confirmed including 23,500 head or about 28 percent or previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1375 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1020-1200 lbs 64.00.
